32903cc.summary: Resolves a queued Regiment trigger action: if the target card is in play or dying it fires its Regiment ability, then runs the shared end-of-action handling. That handling reassembles minions, ends the battle if a hero died (saving results, notifying the opponent), and refreshes turn UI state.
comments: null check: the action must carry a card (the field named isPlayer holds the target card)
log which card's trigger is being resolved
only fire the ability if the card is still in play or dying
remember the action type; it is checked again at the end
if no actions are queued, fix minion positions on both boards (unless this was a reorder)
only do end-of-action checks once no automatic actions remain queued
skipped in tutorial/campaign matches; otherwise check whether either hero died
hero state 5 seems to mean dead; checks the player hero first, then the enemy hero
builds a debug log line describing the dead-hero state (decompiler string-array noise)
already in post-battle: warn and bail out unless the disconnect-loss flag is set
disconnect-loss flag set: record a loss for the local player and run the battle end sequence
normal battle end: enter PostBattle, stop the battle, and tell the opponent the match finished if networked
player won: raise an enemy health change signal so the UI shows enemy hero at 0
look up Elo rating (event leaderboard if any, else player's saved Elo); builds the ranked match result
work out the winner, then fill in the match result with skull milestones for each side
record match length in minutes and save the result
if the player won, flag the win; some match types (0x14, 0xb4, 0xd2) also mark the live-ops handler as human
save the winner and finish the battle; this path returns without the turn UI update
decompiler fall-through: unreachable type/index check failure
no hero died: broadcast while-in-play effects to the board
action finished: clear the 'resolving action' flag
enemy's turn: re-enable enemy minions and recompute the enemy hero's ability to act/attack
hero can act only if alive, not stunned and (not exhausted or bloodthirst), and has no summoning sickness
ferocity/oath heroes: recompute canAct; with summoning sickness switch to the Active attack type
show or hide the hero's attack/ability UI according to what it can do now; decompiler lost the tail here
player's turn: highlight playable cards, activate minions and hero
if no actions remain queued: run garbage collection coroutine and unpause the clock
if the player may act, show the 'no actions left' UI when only end-turn is available (and UI is normal)
still nothing queued: if the player acted manually in a scripted stage, continue the scripted turn
reset the manual-action marker
shared null-reference throw target for the checks above
